title: 第十四章 再见已是路人第二章 灵根异变
content_zh:
萧凉忽然间沉默下来，了解了青山书院，他便明白过来，书院看似没有门槛，但却比有门槛还要难进。
如凌霄阁一般，设定的最低门槛是上品灵根，但凡拥有上品灵根的天骄，他们自然就有了希望。
可是书院，就算你拥有极品灵根，也不见得能够进去。
既然如此，凭什么他萧凉会得到书院的青睐？
“书院规则就是没有规则，就算你已经是某个宗门的弟子，也依旧可以参加书院的考核。”
“也正是因为如此，当年国师才会认为，当他学到静心禅院和自然观的无上功法之后，还能加入书院。”
“可惜书院的没有规则，却是成了他进不去的门槛，管你是天骄还是寻常人，不能进就是不能进。”
苏清绾叹息一声，眼中泛着复杂之色，或许，她曾经也参与过书院的考核？
“所以，凭什么你认为我能去书院山上？”萧凉转过身来，看着苏清绾一字一句地说道。
这个未婚娘子的神秘强大，远远超过他的估计。
苏清绾干咳一声，“我只是认为一切皆有可能，而且昨日里得到了可靠消息，半个月后，山上书院会开山门，山主将收一位新弟子。”
“青山书院开山门，从未明确过要收弟子，这般做还是第一次呢。”
萧凉苦笑一声，“还是那句话，你凭什么觉得会是我？”
“不去试试，怎么知道不是你？”苏清绾眼中充满了鼓励之色。
萧凉道：“王侯将相，宁有种乎？”
苏清绾愣了一下，连连点头，“就是这个意思。”
萧凉忽然陷入了沉默中，仔细想想，若是能够成为青山书院山主的弟子，他的人生恐怕从此改写，大好前途一片光明。
想想就令人激动。
“你要去试试吗？”萧凉问道。
苏清绾点头，“自然是要去看看的。”

“既然如此，还不好好准备一下？”萧凉问道。
苏清绾道：“这些年我一直在准备。”
萧凉眼中闪过凌厉之光，这，才是苏清绾来顺天的原因吗？
“提前恭贺你成为书院山上弟子！”萧凉笑了笑，转身往里面走去。
“喂，你真的不去参加书院考核吗？”苏清绾大声问道。
萧凉不置可否，他总觉得苏清绾的目的没那么简单。
在萧家折腾了许久，苏清绾才离去，萧凉将自己关在屋子里面，将白日里苏清绾的话语再次过了一遍。
而今对这方世界，他的了解还是很少。
“青山书院山上？若真如苏清绾所说，恐怕这几天顺天要很热闹了！”萧凉星目中透着难以形容的明亮光芒。
接下来几天时间里面，萧凉都在打磨他炼气九层的境界，同时也琢磨本命剑无量剑。
这把品级不清的古剑，而今悬浮在萧凉丹田气海中央灵根所在之处，而周围流淌的灵力，则是泛起白色雾气，透着朦胧与神秘。
“第十天了，还有五天！”萧凉轻声自语，出来萧府，往前走了一段，街道上人山人海，沸腾嘈杂。
青山书院山门开，而且还放出话来要收徒一名，可想而知会有多少人往顺天来。
就算不参加书院的考核，看热闹也是可以的。
萧凉走在人群里面，听着人们的议论，才知道皇朝几大家族的天骄已经到了顺天，对于这次书院山上收徒，他们都志在必得。
青山书院山上开门收徒，对萧凉来说的确是一次难得的机会。
但是现在，萧凉并不强求。
去肯定是要去的，至于结果，一切顺其自然。
思虑间，前方忽然传来一阵嘈杂声，萧凉抬头一看，只见街道上站满了人。
萧凉正打算绕开走的，却在这时，一道熟悉的身影映入眼帘，萧凉眼中不由泛起复杂之色。

进入凌霄阁的苏雨涵，竟然就这般悄无声息的出现在他的眼前。
回首往昔，萧凉心下一阵感慨，同时也无比惊骇，短短不到一个月的时间里面，苏雨涵竟然已经突破炼气九成，进入天罡境初期。
看来凌霄阁资源还真是名不虚传，也足以证明凌霄阁对苏雨涵何其重视，倾尽全力培养。
“萧凉，你怎么在这里？”苏雨涵秀眉微微一皱，眼中满是厌烦之色。
萧凉淡然回了一句，“随便走走。”
content_en:
Xiao Liang suddenly fell silent. After getting to know Qingshan Academy, he understood that the academy seemed to have no threshold, but it was more difficult to enter than if there was a threshold.
Like Lingxiao Pavilion, the minimum threshold set is high-grade spiritual roots. As long as the geniuses possess high-grade spiritual roots, they will naturally have hope.
But even if you have the best spiritual roots, you may not be able to enter the academy.
In this case, why would Xiao Liang be favored by the academy?
"The rules of the academy are that there are no rules. Even if you are already a disciple of a certain sect, you can still participate in the academy's assessment."
"It is precisely because of this that the National Master thought that after he learned the supreme skills of Jingxin Zen Academy and Nature Contemplation, he could join the academy."
"It's a pity that the academy has no rules, but it has become a threshold for him to enter. No matter whether you are a genius or an ordinary person, if you can't enter, you can't enter."
Su Qingwan sighed, with a complicated look in her eyes. Perhaps she had also participated in the academy's assessment?
"So, why do you think I can go to Academy Mountain?" Xiao Liang turned around and looked at Su Qingwan and said every word.
The mysterious power of this unmarried woman far exceeded his estimation.
Su Qingwan coughed dryly, "I just think everything is possible, and I got reliable news yesterday. In half a month, the mountain academy will open its gates, and the mountain master will accept a new disciple."
"When Qingshan Academy opened its gate, it was never clear that it would accept disciples. This is the first time it has done so."
Xiao Liang smiled bitterly, "It's the same thing, why do you think it will be me?"
"If I don't try, how will I know it's not you?" Su Qingwan's eyes were full of encouragement.
Xiao Liang said: "Princes, generals and prime ministers, would you rather have the seed?"
Su Qingwan was stunned for a moment and nodded repeatedly, "That's what I mean."
Xiao Liang suddenly fell into silence. If he thought about it carefully, if he could become the disciple of the mountain master of Qingshan Academy, his life would probably be rewritten from now on, and his future would be bright.
It’s exciting to think about.
"Are you going to try it?" Xiao Liang asked.
Su Qingwan nodded, "Of course I want to go take a look."
"In that case, why don't you get ready?" Xiao Liang asked.
Su Qingwan said: "I have been preparing for these years."
A sharp light flashed in Xiao Liang's eyes. Is this the reason why Su Qingwan came to Shuntian?
"Congratulations in advance for becoming a disciple on Academy Mountain!" Xiao Liang smiled, turned around and walked inside.
"Hey, are you really not going to take the academy exam?" Su Qingwan asked loudly.
Xiao Liang was noncommittal. He always felt that Su Qingwan's purpose was not that simple.
After struggling in the Xiao family for a long time, Su Qingwan left. Xiao Liang locked himself in the room and recited Su Qingwan's words during the day.
Today, he still knows very little about this world.
"On Qingshan Academy Mountain? If it's as Su Qingwan said, I'm afraid Shuntian will be very busy these days!" Xiao Liangxing's eyes showed an indescribable bright light.
In the next few days, Xiao Liang spent time polishing his ninth level of Qi refining, and at the same time pondering the natal sword Wuliangjian.
This ancient sword of unknown grade is now suspended in the center of Xiao Liang's Dantian Qi Sea where the spiritual root is, and the spiritual power flowing around it is filled with white mist, revealing hazy and mysterious.
"It's the tenth day, there are still five more days!" Xiao Liang whispered to himself. He came out of Xiao's Mansion and walked forward for a while. The streets were crowded and noisy.
The gate of Qingshan Academy is open, and they have announced that they will accept a disciple. You can imagine how many people will come to Sunchon.
Even if you don't take the academy's assessment, you can still watch the fun.
Xiao Liang walked among the crowd and listened to people's discussions, only to know that the geniuses of several major families in the dynasty had arrived in Shuntian. They were all determined to recruit disciples on Academy Mountain this time.
The opening of Qingshan Academy to accept disciples is indeed a rare opportunity for Xiao Liang.
But now, Xiao Liang doesn't force it.You definitely have to go, and as for the result, let everything take its course.
While thinking, there was a sudden noise in front of him. Xiao Liang looked up and saw that the street was full of people.
Xiao Liang was about to go around, but at this moment, a familiar figure came into view, and Xiao Liang couldn't help but have a complicated look in his eyes.
Su Yuhan, who entered Lingxiao Pavilion, appeared in front of him quietly.
Looking back on the past, Xiao Liang was filled with emotion and at the same time extremely horrified. In less than a month, Su Yuhan had broken through 90% of Qi Refining and entered the early stage of Tiangang Realm.
It seems that Lingxiao Pavilion's resources are truly well-deserved, which is enough to prove how much Lingxiao Pavilion attaches great importance to Su Yuhan and devotes all its efforts to training her.
"Xiao Liang, why are you here?" Su Yuhan frowned slightly, her eyes full of boredom.
Xiao Liang replied calmly, "Just take a walk."
